description: Full-text search across published news, newsletter issues, podcast episodes, public entity pages, funding rounds and products. Result kinds: news, newsletter, podcast, company, investor, person, topic, country, funding_round, product; funding_round results also carry company, round_type, category, amount, currency, display_amount and announced_at. Arguments: q (or query): text to search for, at least 2 characters — required, this tool has no plain-list mode. Unknown arguments are rejected.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for (required, min 2 characters).

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

name: search_content
title: Search the publication
